info.longName: Global X MSCI SuperDividend EAFE ETF

funds_data.description: The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index tracks the performance of 50 equally-weighted companies that rank among the highest dividend yielding equity securities in Europe, Australasia and the Far East, as defined by MSCI, the provider of the underlying index ("index provider").
